in_marathi.name: Akhilesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akhilesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Akhi means 'eye' and Ilesh means 'unconquerable'. The name Akhilesh is derived from the Hindu god Indra, who is believed to have the power to see the past, present and future. The name symbolizes the power of vision and the ability to overcome obstacles.
